english_translation: Knowledge is superior to blind action, meditation is superior to knowledge, renunciation of the fruit of action is superior to meditation, and peace follows from renunciation.
chapter_title_meaning: The Yoga of Devotion

sanskrit_text: अद्वेष्टा सर्वभूतानां मैत्रः करुण एव च।निर्ममो निरहङ्कारः समदुःखसुखः क्षमी।।12.13।।
english_translation: He who is incapable of hatred towards any being, who is kind and compassionate, free from selfishness, without pride, equable in pleasure and pain, and forgiving—
chapter_title_meaning: The Yoga of Devotion

sanskrit_text: सन्तुष्टः सततं योगी यतात्मा दृढनिश्चयः।मय्यर्पितमनोबुद्धिर्यो मद्भक्तः स मे प्रियः।।12.14।।
english_translation: Always content, self-centered, self-controlled, resolute, with mind and reason dedicated to Me, such a devotee of Mine is beloved to Me.
chapter_title_meaning: The Yoga of Devotion

sanskrit_text: यस्मान्नोद्विजते लोको लोकान्नोद्विजते च यः।हर्षामर्षभयोद्वेगैर्मुक्तो यः स च मे प्रियः।।12.15।।
english_translation: He who does not harm the world, and whom the world cannot harm, who is not carried away by any impulse of joy, anger, or fear; such a one is My beloved.
chapter_title_meaning: The Yoga of Devotion

sanskrit_text: अनपेक्षः शुचिर्दक्ष उदासीनो गतव्यथः।सर्वारम्भपरित्यागी यो मद्भक्तः स मे प्रियः।।12.16।।
english_translation: He who expects nothing, is pure, watchful, indifferent, unruffled, and renounces all initiative—such a one is My beloved.
chapter_title_meaning: The Yoga of Devotion

sanskrit_text: यो न हृष्यति न द्वेष्टि न शोचति न काङ्क्षति।शुभाशुभपरित्यागी भक्ितमान्यः स मे प्रियः।।12.17।।
english_translation: He who is beyond joy and hate, who neither laments nor desires, to whom good and evil fortunes are the same, such a one is beloved to Me.
chapter_title_meaning: The Yoga of Devotion

sanskrit_text: समः शत्रौ च मित्रे च तथा मानापमानयोः।शीतोष्णसुखदुःखेषु समः सङ्गविवर्जितः।।12.18।।
english_translation: He to whom friend and foe are alike, who welcomes equally honor and dishonor, heat and cold, pleasure and pain, and who is enamored of nothing—
chapter_title_meaning: The Yoga of Devotion

sanskrit_text: तुल्यनिन्दास्तुतिर्मौनी सन्तुष्टो येनकेनचित्।अनिकेतः स्थिरमतिर्भक्ितमान्मे प्रियो नरः।।12.19।।
english_translation: Who is indifferent to praise and censure, enjoys silence, is content with every fate, has no fixed abode, is steadfast in mind, and filled with devotion—such a one is My beloved.
chapter_title_meaning: The Yoga of Devotion

sanskrit_text: ये तु धर्म्यामृतमिदं यथोक्तं पर्युपासते।श्रद्दधाना मत्परमा भक्तास्तेऽतीव मे प्रियाः।।12.20।।
english_translation: Verily, those who love the spiritual wisdom as I have taught, whose faith never wavers, and who focus their entire being on Me, they are indeed My most beloved.
chapter_title_meaning: The Yoga of Devotion

sanskrit_text: अर्जुन उवाच प्रकृतिं पुरुषं चैव क्षेत्रं क्षेत्रज्ञमेव च। एतद्वेदितुमिच्छामि ज्ञानं ज्ञेयं च केशव।।13.1।।
english_translation: Arjuna asked, "My Lord, who is God, what is Nature, what is Matter, and what is the Self? What is Wisdom, and what is worth knowing? I wish to have this explained."
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field

sanskrit_text: श्री भगवानुवाचइदं शरीरं कौन्तेय क्षेत्रमित्यभिधीयते।एतद्यो वेत्ति तं प्राहुः क्षेत्रज्ञ इति तद्विदः।।13.2।।
english_translation: Lord Shri Krishna replied: O Arjuna! The body of a person is the playground of the Self; and That which knows the activities of Matter, sages call the Self.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field

sanskrit_text: क्षेत्रज्ञं चापि मां विद्धि सर्वक्षेत्रेषु भारत। क्षेत्रक्षेत्रज्ञयोर्ज्ञानं यत्तज्ज्ञानं मतं मम।।13.3।।
english_translation: I am the omniscient Self that abides in the realm of matter; knowledge of matter and of the all-knowing Self is wisdom.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field

sanskrit_text: तत्क्षेत्रं यच्च यादृक् च यद्विकारि यतश्च यत्।स च यो यत्प्रभावश्च तत्समासेन मे श्रृणु।।13.4।।
english_translation: What is called Matter, of what it is composed, whence it came, and why it changes, what the Self is, and what its power - this I will now briefly set forth.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field

sanskrit_text: ऋषिभिर्बहुधा गीतं छन्दोभिर्विविधैः पृथक्।ब्रह्मसूत्रपदैश्चैव हेतुमद्भिर्विनिश्िचतैः।।13.5।।
english_translation: Seers have sung of it in various ways, in many hymns and sacred Vedic songs, weighty in thought and convincing in their arguments.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field

sanskrit_text: महाभूतान्यहङ्कारो बुद्धिरव्यक्तमेव च।इन्द्रियाणि दशैकं च पञ्च चेन्द्रियगोचराः।।13.6।।
english_translation: The five great fundamentals—earth, fire, air, water, and ether—personality, intellect, the mysterious life force, the ten organs of perception and action, the mind, and the five domains of sensation—
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field

sanskrit_text: इच्छा द्वेषः सुखं दुःखं सङ्घातश्चेतनाधृतिः।एतत्क्षेत्रं समासेन सविकारमुदाहृतम्।।13.7।।
english_translation: Desire, aversion, pleasure, pain, sympathy, vitality, and the persistent clinging to life—these are, in brief, the constituents of changing matter.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field

sanskrit_text: अमानित्वमदम्भित्वमहिंसा क्षान्तिरार्जवम्।आचार्योपासनं शौचं स्थैर्यमात्मविनिग्रहः।।13.8।।
english_translation: Humility, sincerity, harmlessness, forgiveness, rectitude, service to the Master, purity, steadfastness, and self-control;
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field

sanskrit_text: इन्द्रियार्थेषु वैराग्यमनहङ्कार एव च।जन्ममृत्युजराव्याधिदुःखदोषानुदर्शनम्।।13.9।।
english_translation: Renouncing the delights of the senses, being without pride, having a right understanding of the painful problem of birth and death, and of age and sickness;
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field

sanskrit_text: असक्ितरनभिष्वङ्गः पुत्रदारगृहादिषु।नित्यं च समचित्तत्वमिष्टानिष्टोपपत्तिषु।।13.10।।
english_translation: Indifference, non-attachment to sex, progeny, or home, equanimity in both good fortune and bad;
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field

sanskrit_text: मयि चानन्ययोगेन भक्ितरव्यभिचारिणी।विविक्तदेशसेवित्वमरतिर्जनसंसदि।।13.11।।
english_translation: Unswerving devotion to Me, with concentration on Me and Me alone, a love for solitude, and indifference to social life;
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field

sanskrit_text: अध्यात्मज्ञाननित्यत्वं तत्त्वज्ञानार्थदर्शनम्।एतज्ज्ञानमिति प्रोक्तमज्ञानं यदतोन्यथा।।13.12।।
english_translation: Constant yearning for the knowledge of the Self, and pondering over the lessons of the great Truth—this is wisdom; all else is ignorance.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field

sanskrit_text: ज्ञेयं यत्तत्प्रवक्ष्यामि यज्ज्ञात्वाऽमृतमश्नुते।अनादिमत्परं ब्रह्म न सत्तन्नासदुच्यते।।13.13।।
english_translation: I will now speak to you of that great truth which one ought to know, since by it one will attain immortal bliss—that which is without beginning, the eternal spirit which dwells in me, neither with form nor without it.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field

sanskrit_text: सर्वतः पाणिपादं तत्सर्वतोऽक्षिशिरोमुखम्।सर्वतः श्रुतिमल्लोके सर्वमावृत्य तिष्ठति।।13.14।।
english_translation: Everywhere are Its hands and feet; everywhere It has eyes that see, heads that think, and mouths that speak; everywhere It listens; It dwells in all the worlds and envelops them all.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field

sanskrit_text: सर्वेन्द्रियगुणाभासं सर्वेन्द्रियविवर्जितम्।असक्तं सर्वभृच्चैव निर्गुणं गुणभोक्तृ च।।13.15।।
english_translation: Beyond the senses, it yet shines through every sense perception; bound to nothing, it yet sustains everything; unaffected by the qualities, it still enjoys them all.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field

sanskrit_text: बहिरन्तश्च भूतानामचरं चरमेव च।सूक्ष्मत्वात्तदविज्ञेयं दूरस्थं चान्तिके च तत्।।13.16।।
english_translation: It is within all beings, yet outside; motionless yet moving; too subtle to be perceived; far away yet ever near.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field

sanskrit_text: अविभक्तं च भूतेषु विभक्तमिव च स्थितम्।भूतभर्तृ च तज्ज्ञेयं ग्रसिष्णु प्रभविष्णु च।।13.17।।
english_translation: In all beings, undivided yet living in division, it is the upholder of all, both creator and destroyer alike.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field

sanskrit_text: ज्योतिषामपि तज्ज्योतिस्तमसः परमुच्यते।ज्ञानं ज्ञेयं ज्ञानगम्यं हृदि सर्वस्य विष्ठितम्।।13.18।।
english_translation: It is the light of lights, beyond the reach of darkness; the wisdom, the only thing worth knowing or that wisdom can teach; the presence in the hearts of all.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field

sanskrit_text: इति क्षेत्रं तथा ज्ञानं ज्ञेयं चोक्तं समासतः।मद्भक्त एतद्विज्ञाय मद्भावायोपपद्यते।।13.19।।
english_translation: Thus, I have briefly told you what Matter is, the Self worth realizing, and what Wisdom is. He who is devoted to Me knows, and he will assuredly enter into Me.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field

sanskrit_text: प्रकृतिं पुरुषं चैव विद्ध्यनादी उभावपि।विकारांश्च गुणांश्चैव विद्धि प्रकृतिसंभवान्।।13.20।।
english_translation: Know further that Nature and God have no beginning, and that differences in character and quality originate from Nature only.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field

sanskrit_text: कार्यकारणकर्तृत्वे हेतुः प्रकृतिरुच्यते।पुरुषः सुखदुःखानां भोक्तृत्वे हेतुरुच्यते।।13.21।।
english_translation: Nature is the law that generates cause and effect; God is the source of all pleasure and pain.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field

sanskrit_text: पुरुषः प्रकृतिस्थो हि भुङ्क्ते प्रकृतिजान्गुणान्।कारणं गुणसङ्गोऽस्य सदसद्योनिजन्मसु।।13.22।।
english_translation: God, dwelling in the heart of Nature, experiences the qualities that Nature brings forth; and His affinity towards these qualities is the reason for His living in a good or evil body.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field

sanskrit_text: उपद्रष्टाऽनुमन्ता च भर्ता भोक्ता महेश्वरः।परमात्मेति चाप्युक्तो देहेऽस्मिन्पुरुषः परः।।13.23।।
english_translation: Thus, in the body of man dwells the Supreme God; He who sees, permits, upholds, and enjoys is the Highest God and the Highest Self.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field

sanskrit_text: य एवं वेत्ति पुरुषं प्रकृतिं च गुणैःसह।सर्वथा वर्तमानोऽपि न स भूयोऽभिजायते।।13.24।।
english_translation: He who understands God and Nature, along with her qualities, whatever his condition in life may be, will not come back to earth.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field

sanskrit_text: ध्यानेनात्मनि पश्यन्ति केचिदात्मानमात्मना।अन्ये सांख्येन योगेन कर्मयोगेन चापरे।।13.25।।
english_translation: Some realize the Supreme by meditating, with its aid, on the Self within; others by pure reason; and still others by right action.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field

sanskrit_text: अन्ये त्वेवमजानन्तः श्रुत्वाऽन्येभ्य उपासते।तेऽपि चातितरन्त्येव मृत्युं श्रुतिपरायणाः।।13.26।।
english_translation: Others, again, having no direct knowledge but only hearing from others, still worship, and, if they are true to the teachings, they too will cross the sea of death.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field

sanskrit_text: यावत्सञ्जायते किञ्चित्सत्त्वं स्थावरजङ्गमम्।क्षेत्रक्षेत्रज्ञसंयोगात्तद्विद्धि भरतर्षभ।।13.27।।
english_translation: Wherever life is seen in things movable or immovable, it is the result of the combination of Matter and Spirit.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field

sanskrit_text: समं सर्वेषु भूतेषु तिष्ठन्तं परमेश्वरम्।विनश्यत्स्वविनश्यन्तं यः पश्यति स पश्यति।।13.28।।
english_translation: He who can see the Supreme Lord in all beings, the Imperishable amidst the perishable, he is the one who truly sees.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field

sanskrit_text: समं पश्यन्हि सर्वत्र समवस्थितमीश्वरम्।न हिनस्त्यात्मनाऽऽत्मानं ततो याति परां गतिम्।।13.29।।
english_translation: Beholding the Lord equally in all things, his actions do not mar his spiritual life but lead him to the heights of bliss.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field

sanskrit_text: प्रकृत्यैव च कर्माणि क्रियमाणानि सर्वशः।यः पश्यति तथाऽऽत्मानमकर्तारं स पश्यति।।13.30।।
english_translation: He who understands that it is only the Law of Nature that brings action to fruition, and that the Self never acts, alone knows the Truth.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field

sanskrit_text: यदा भूतपृथग्भावमेकस्थमनुपश्यति।तत एव च विस्तारं ब्रह्म सम्पद्यते तदा।।13.31।।
english_translation: He who sees the diverse forms of life all rooted in One and growing forth from Him, shall indeed find the Absolute.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field

sanskrit_text: अनादित्वान्निर्गुणत्वात्परमात्मायमव्ययः।शरीरस्थोऽपि कौन्तेय न करोति न लिप्यते।।13.32।।
english_translation: The Supreme Spirit, O Prince, is without beginning, has no qualities, and is imperishable. Though it is within the body, it does not act, nor is it affected by action.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field

sanskrit_text: यथा सर्वगतं सौक्ष्म्यादाकाशं नोपलिप्यते।सर्वत्रावस्थितो देहे तथाऽऽत्मा नोपलिप्यते।।13.33।।
english_translation: As space, though present everywhere, remains unaffected due to its subtlety, so too the Self, though present in all forms, retains its purity unalloyed.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field

sanskrit_text: यथा प्रकाशयत्येकः कृत्स्नं लोकमिमं रविः।क्षेत्रं क्षेत्री तथा कृत्स्नं प्रकाशयति भारत।।13.34।।
english_translation: As the one Sun illuminates the entire earth, so the Lord illuminates the entire universe.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field

sanskrit_text: क्षेत्रक्षेत्रज्ञयोरेवमन्तरं ज्ञानचक्षुषा।भूतप्रकृतिमोक्षं च ये विदुर्यान्ति ते परम्।।13.35।।
english_translation: Those who, with the eyes of wisdom, thus see the difference between Matter and Spirit, and know how to liberate life from the Law of Nature, attain the Supreme.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field

sanskrit_text: श्री भगवानुवाचपरं भूयः प्रवक्ष्यामि ज्ञानानां ज्ञानमुत्तमम्।यज्ज्ञात्वा मुनयः सर्वे परां सिद्धिमितो गताः।।14.1।।
english_translation: Lord Shri Krishna continued: Now I will reveal to you the wisdom that is beyond knowledge, by attaining which the sages have reached perfection.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Understanding the Three Modes of Material Nature

sanskrit_text: इदं ज्ञानमुपाश्रित्य मम साधर्म्यमागताः।सर्गेऽपि नोपजायन्ते प्रलये न व्यथन्ति च।।14.2।।
english_translation: Dwelling in wisdom and realizing My divinity, they are not reborn when the universe is recreated at the beginning of every cycle, nor are they affected when it is dissolved.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Understanding the Three Modes of Material Nature

sanskrit_text: मम योनिर्महद्ब्रह्म तस्मिन् गर्भं दधाम्यहम्।संभवः सर्वभूतानां ततो भवति भारत।।14.3।।
english_translation: The eternal cosmos is My womb, in which I plant the seed from which all beings are born, O prince!
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Understanding the Three Modes of Material Nature

sanskrit_text: सर्वयोनिषु कौन्तेय मूर्तयः सम्भवन्ति याः।तासां ब्रह्म महद्योनिरहं बीजप्रदः पिता।।14.4।।
english_translation: O illustrious son of Kunti! Through whatever wombs men are born, it is the Spirit itself that conceives, and I am their father.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Understanding the Three Modes of Material Nature

sanskrit_text: सत्त्वं रजस्तम इति गुणाः प्रकृतिसंभवाः।निबध्नन्ति महाबाहो देहे देहिनमव्ययम्।।14.5।।
english_translation: Purity, passion, and ignorance are the qualities that the law of nature brings forth. They fetter the free spirit in all beings.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Understanding the Three Modes of Material Nature

sanskrit_text: तत्र सत्त्वं निर्मलत्वात्प्रकाशकमनामयम्।सुखसङ्गेन बध्नाति ज्ञानसङ्गेन चानघ।।14.6।।
english_translation: O Sinless One! Of these, purity, being luminous, strong, and invulnerable, binds one with its yearning for happiness and illumination.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Understanding the Three Modes of Material Nature

sanskrit_text: रजो रागात्मकं विद्धि तृष्णासङ्गसमुद्भवम्।तन्निबध्नाति कौन्तेय कर्मसङ्गेन देहिनम्।।14.7।।
english_translation: Passion, engendered by thirst for pleasure and attachment, binds the soul through its fondness for activities.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Understanding the Three Modes of Material Nature

sanskrit_text: तमस्त्वज्ञानजं विद्धि मोहनं सर्वदेहिनाम्।प्रमादालस्यनिद्राभिस्तन्निबध्नाति भारत।।14.8।।
english_translation: But Ignorance, the product of darkness, stupefies the senses of all embodied beings, binding them with chains of folly, indolence, and lethargy.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Understanding the Three Modes of Material Nature

sanskrit_text: सत्त्वं सुखे सञ्जयति रजः कर्मणि भारत।ज्ञानमावृत्य तु तमः प्रमादे सञ्जयत्युत।।14.9।।
english_translation: Purity brings happiness, passion brings commotion, and ignorance, which obscures wisdom, leads to a life of failure.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Understanding the Three Modes of Material Nature

sanskrit_text: रजस्तमश्चाभिभूय सत्त्वं भवति भारत।रजः सत्त्वं तमश्चैव तमः सत्त्वं रजस्तथा।।14.10।।
english_translation: O Prince! Purity prevails when passion and ignorance are overcome; passion, when purity and ignorance are overcome; and ignorance when it is overcome by purity and passion.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Understanding the Three Modes of Material Nature

sanskrit_text: सर्वद्वारेषु देहेऽस्मिन्प्रकाश उपजायते।ज्ञानं यदा तदा विद्याद्विवृद्धं सत्त्वमित्युत।।14.11।।
english_translation: When the light of knowledge gleams forth from all the gates of the body, then be sure that purity prevails.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Understanding the Three Modes of Material Nature

sanskrit_text: लोभः प्रवृत्तिरारम्भः कर्मणामशमः स्पृहा।रजस्येतानि जायन्ते विवृद्धे भरतर्षभ।।14.12।।
english_translation: O best of Indians! Avarice, the impulse to act, and the beginning of action itself are all due to the dominance of passion.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Understanding the Three Modes of Material Nature

sanskrit_text: अप्रकाशोऽप्रवृत्तिश्च प्रमादो मोह एव च।तमस्येतानि जायन्ते विवृद्धे कुरुनन्दन।।14.13।।
english_translation: Darkness, stagnation, folly, and infatuation are the results of the dominance of ignorance, O joy of the Kuru clan!
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Understanding the Three Modes of Material Nature

sanskrit_text: यदा सत्त्वे प्रवृद्धे तु प्रलयं याति देहभृत्।तदोत्तमविदां लोकानमलान्प्रतिपद्यते।।14.14।।
english_translation: When purity prevails, the soul, upon leaving the body, passes on to the pure regions where those who know the Highest reside.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Understanding the Three Modes of Material Nature

sanskrit_text: रजसि प्रलयं गत्वा कर्मसङ्गिषु जायते।तथा प्रलीनस्तमसि मूढयोनिषु जायते।।14.15।।
english_translation: When passion prevails, the soul is reborn among those who love activity; when ignorance rules, it enters the wombs of the ignorant.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Understanding the Three Modes of Material Nature

sanskrit_text: कर्मणः सुकृतस्याहुः सात्त्विकं निर्मलं फलम्।रजसस्तु फलं दुःखमज्ञानं तमसः फलम्।।14.16।।
english_translation: They say the fruit of a meritorious action is spotless and pure; the outcome of passion is misery, and of ignorance, darkness.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Understanding the Three Modes of Material Nature

sanskrit_text: सत्त्वात्सञ्जायते ज्ञानं रजसो लोभ एव च।प्रमादमोहौ तमसो भवतोऽज्ञानमेव च।।14.17।।
english_translation: Purity engenders wisdom, passion avarice, and ignorance folly, infatuation, and darkness.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Understanding the Three Modes of Material Nature

sanskrit_text: ऊर्ध्वं गच्छन्ति सत्त्वस्था मध्ये तिष्ठन्ति राजसाः।जघन्यगुणवृत्तिस्था अधो गच्छन्ति तामसाः।।14.18।।
english_translation: When purity is in the ascendant, the man evolves; when passion is in the ascendant, he neither evolves nor degenerates; when ignorance is in the ascendant, he is lost.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Understanding the Three Modes of Material Nature

sanskrit_text: नान्यं गुणेभ्यः कर्तारं यदा द्रष्टानुपश्यति।गुणेभ्यश्च परं वेत्ति मद्भावं सोऽधिगच्छति।।14.19।।
english_translation: As soon as one understands that it is only the qualities that act and nothing else, and perceives that which is beyond, they attain My divine nature.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Understanding the Three Modes of Material Nature

sanskrit_text: गुणानेतानतीत्य त्रीन्देही देहसमुद्भवान्।जन्ममृत्युजरादुःखैर्विमुक्तोऽमृतमश्नुते।।14.20।।
english_translation: When the soul transcends the Qualities, which are the real cause of physical existence, then, freed from birth and death, from old age and misery, he drinks the nectar of immortality.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Understanding the Three Modes of Material Nature

sanskrit_text: अर्जुन उवाचकैर्लिंगैस्त्रीन्गुणानेतानतीतो भवति प्रभो।किमाचारः कथं चैतांस्त्रीन्गुणानतिवर्तते।।14.21।।
english_translation: Arjuna asked, "My Lord, how can one recognize someone who has transcended the qualities? How do they act and live beyond them?"
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Understanding the Three Modes of Material Nature

sanskrit_text: श्री भगवानुवाचप्रकाशं च प्रवृत्तिं च मोहमेव च पाण्डव।न द्वेष्टि सम्प्रवृत्तानि न निवृत्तानि काङ्क्षति।।14.22।।
english_translation: Lord Shri Krishna replied: O Prince! He who does not shun the quality that is present and does not long for that which is absent;
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Understanding the Three Modes of Material Nature

sanskrit_text: उदासीनवदासीनो गुणैर्यो न विचाल्यते।गुणा वर्तन्त इत्येव योऽवतिष्ठति नेङ्गते।।14.23।।
english_translation: He who maintains an attitude of indifference, who is not disturbed by the qualities, who realizes that it is only they who act, and remains calm;
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Understanding the Three Modes of Material Nature

sanskrit_text: समदुःखसुखः स्वस्थः समलोष्टाश्मकाञ्चनः।तुल्यप्रियाप्रियो धीरस्तुल्यनिन्दात्मसंस्तुतिः।।14.24।।
english_translation: Who accepts pain and pleasure as they come, is centered in their Self, to whom a piece of clay, stone, or gold are all the same, who neither likes nor dislikes, who is steadfast, indifferent alike to praise or censure;
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Understanding the Three Modes of Material Nature

sanskrit_text: मानापमानयोस्तुल्यस्तुल्यो मित्रारिपक्षयोः।सर्वारम्भपरित्यागी गुणातीतः स उच्यते।।14.25।।
english_translation: Who looks equally upon honor and dishonor, loves friends and foes alike, and abandons all initiative, such is he who transcends the qualities.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Understanding the Three Modes of Material Nature

sanskrit_text: मां च योऽव्यभिचारेण भक्ितयोगेन सेवते।स गुणान्समतीत्यैतान् ब्रह्मभूयाय कल्पते।।14.26।।
english_translation: And he who serves Me alone, with unwavering devotion, shall overcome the Qualities and become one with the Eternal.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Understanding the Three Modes of Material Nature

sanskrit_text: ब्रह्मणो हि प्रतिष्ठाऽहममृतस्याव्ययस्य च।शाश्वतस्य च धर्मस्य सुखस्यैकान्तिकस्य च।।14.27।।
english_translation: For I am the home of the spirit, the continual source of immortality, eternal righteousness, and infinite joy.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Understanding the Three Modes of Material Nature

sanskrit_text: श्री भगवानुवाचऊर्ध्वमूलमधःशाखमश्वत्थं प्राहुरव्ययम्।छन्दांसि यस्य पर्णानि यस्तं वेद स वेदवित्।।15.1।।
english_translation: Lord Shri Krishna continued: This phenomenal creation, which is both ephemeral and eternal, is like a tree, with its seed above in the Highest and its ramifications below on this earth. The scriptures are its leaves, and he who understands this knows.
chapter_title_meaning: The Yoga of the Supreme Divine Personality

sanskrit_text: अधश्चोर्ध्वं प्रसृतास्तस्य शाखा गुणप्रवृद्धा विषयप्रवालाः।अधश्च मूलान्यनुसन्ततानि कर्मानुबन्धीनि मनुष्यलोके।।15.2।।
english_translation: Its branches shoot upwards and downwards, deriving their nourishment from the qualities; its buds are the objects of sense; and its roots, which follow the law, causing man's regeneration and degeneration, pierce downwards into the soil.
chapter_title_meaning: The Yoga of the Supreme Divine Personality

sanskrit_text: न रूपमस्येह तथोपलभ्यते नान्तो न चादिर्न च संप्रतिष्ठा।अश्वत्थमेनं सुविरूढमूल मसङ्गशस्त्रेण दृढेन छित्त्वा।।15.3।।
english_translation: In this world, its true form is not known, neither its origin nor its end, and its strength is not understood—until the tree, with its roots striking deep into the earth, is hewn down by the sharp axe of non-attachment.
chapter_title_meaning: The Yoga of the Supreme Divine Personality

sanskrit_text: ततः पदं तत्परिमार्गितव्य यस्मिन्गता न निवर्तन्ति भूयः।तमेव चाद्यं पुरुषं प्रपद्ये यतः प्रवृत्तिः प्रसृता पुराणी।।15.4।।
english_translation: Beyond lies the path, from which, once found, there is no return. This is the Primal God from whom this ancient creation has sprung.
chapter_title_meaning: The Yoga of the Supreme Divine Personality

sanskrit_text: निर्मानमोहा जितसङ्गदोषा अध्यात्मनित्या विनिवृत्तकामाः।द्वन्द्वैर्विमुक्ताः सुखदुःखसंज्ञै र्गच्छन्त्यमूढाः पदमव्ययं तत्।।15.5।।
english_translation: The wise attain Eternity when, freed from pride and delusion, they have conquered their love for the things of sense; when, renouncing desire and fixing their gaze on the Self, they cease to be tossed to and fro by the opposing sensations, such as pleasure and pain.
chapter_title_meaning: The Yoga of the Supreme Divine Personality

sanskrit_text: न तद्भासयते सूर्यो न शशाङ्को न पावकः।यद्गत्वा न निवर्तन्ते तद्धाम परमं मम।।15.6।।
english_translation: Neither the sun, nor the moon, nor fire shines there. Those who go there never come back. For, O Arjuna, that is my celestial home!
chapter_title_meaning: The Yoga of the Supreme Divine Personality

sanskrit_text: ममैवांशो जीवलोके जीवभूतः सनातनः।मनःषष्ठानीन्द्रियाणि प्रकृतिस्थानि कर्षति।।15.7।।
english_translation: It is only a very small part of My Eternal Self, which is the life of the universe, that draws around itself the six senses, with the mind being the last, which have their source in Nature.
chapter_title_meaning: The Yoga of the Supreme Divine Personality

sanskrit_text: शरीरं यदवाप्नोति यच्चाप्युत्क्रामतीश्वरः।गृहीत्वैतानि संयाति वायुर्गन्धानिवाशयात्।।15.8।।
english_translation: When the Supreme Lord enters a body or leaves it, He gathers these senses together and travels with them, as the wind gathers perfume while passing through the flowers.
chapter_title_meaning: The Yoga of the Supreme Divine Personality

sanskrit_text: श्रोत्रं चक्षुः स्पर्शनं च रसनं घ्राणमेव च।अधिष्ठाय मनश्चायं विषयानुपसेवते।।15.9।।
english_translation: He is the perception of the ear, the eye, the touch, the taste, the smell, and the mind; and the enjoyment of the things they perceive is also His.
chapter_title_meaning: The Yoga of the Supreme Divine Personality

sanskrit_text: उत्क्रामन्तं स्थितं वापि भुञ्जानं वा गुणान्वितम्।विमूढा नानुपश्यन्ति पश्यन्ति ज्ञानचक्षुषः।।15.10।।
english_translation: The ignorant do not see that it is He who is present in life and departs at death, or even that it is He who enjoys pleasure through the qualities. Only the eye of wisdom sees this.
chapter_title_meaning: The Yoga of the Supreme Divine Personality

sanskrit_text: यतन्तो योगिनश्चैनं पश्यन्त्यात्मन्यवस्थितम्।यतन्तोऽप्यकृतात्मानो नैनं पश्यन्त्यचेतसः।।15.11।।
english_translation: The saints, with great effort, find Him within themselves; however, the unintelligent, despite their efforts, cannot control their minds.
chapter_title_meaning: The Yoga of the Supreme Divine Personality

sanskrit_text: यदादित्यगतं तेजो जगद्भासयतेऽखिलम्।यच्चन्द्रमसि यच्चाग्नौ तत्तेजो विद्धि मामकम्।।15.12।।
english_translation: Remember that the light which proceeds from the sun, illuminating the whole world, and the light which is in the moon, and that which is in the fire, all are born of me.
chapter_title_meaning: The Yoga of the Supreme Divine Personality

sanskrit_text: गामाविश्य च भूतानि धारयाम्यहमोजसा।पुष्णामि चौषधीः सर्वाः सोमो भूत्वा रसात्मकः।।15.13।।
english_translation: I enter this world and animate all My creatures with My vitality; and by My cool moonbeams, I nourish the plants.
chapter_title_meaning: The Yoga of the Supreme Divine Personality

sanskrit_text: अहं वैश्वानरो भूत्वा प्राणिनां देहमाश्रितः।प्राणापानसमायुक्तः पचाम्यन्नं चतुर्विधम्।।15.14।।
english_translation: Becoming the fire of life, I pass into their bodies and, uniting with the vital streams of Prāṇa and Apāna, I digest the various kinds of food.
chapter_title_meaning: The Yoga of the Supreme Divine Personality

sanskrit_text: सर्वस्य चाहं हृदि सन्निविष्टो मत्तः स्मृतिर्ज्ञानमपोहनं च।वेदैश्च सर्वैरहमेव वेद्यो वेदान्तकृद्वेदविदेव चाहम्।।15.15।।
english_translation: I am enthroned in the hearts of all; memory, wisdom, and discrimination owe their origins to Me. I am He Who is to be realized in the scriptures; I inspire their wisdom, and I know their truth.
chapter_title_meaning: The Yoga of the Supreme Divine Personality

sanskrit_text: द्वाविमौ पुरुषौ लोके क्षरश्चाक्षर एव च।क्षरः सर्वाणि भूतानि कूटस्थोऽक्षर उच्यते।।15.16।।
english_translation: There are two aspects in Nature: the perishable and the imperishable. All life in this world belongs to the former, while the unchanging element belongs to the latter.
chapter_title_meaning: The Yoga of the Supreme Divine Personality

sanskrit_text: उत्तमः पुरुषस्त्वन्यः परमात्मेत्युदाहृतः।यो लोकत्रयमाविश्य बिभर्त्यव्यय ईश्वरः।।15.17।।
english_translation: But I am higher than all, the Supreme God, the Absolute Self, the Eternal Lord, who pervades and upholds all the worlds.
chapter_title_meaning: The Yoga of the Supreme Divine Personality

sanskrit_text: यस्मात्क्षरमतीतोऽहमक्षरादपि चोत्तमः।अतोऽस्मि लोके वेदे च प्रथितः पुरुषोत्तमः।।15.18।।
english_translation: I am beyond comparison with the Eternal and the non-eternal; I am known as the Supreme Personality, the Highest God, by scriptures and sages.
chapter_title_meaning: The Yoga of the Supreme Divine Personality

sanskrit_text: यो मामेवमसम्मूढो जानाति पुरुषोत्तमम्।स सर्वविद्भजति मां सर्वभावेन भारत।।15.19।।
english_translation: He who, with unclouded vision, sees Me as the Lord-God, knows all that there is to be known and will always worship Me with his whole heart.
chapter_title_meaning: The Yoga of the Supreme Divine Personality

sanskrit_text: इति गुह्यतमं शास्त्रमिदमुक्तं मयाऽनघ।एतद्बुद्ध्वा बुद्धिमान्स्यात्कृतकृत्यश्च भारत।।15.20।।
english_translation: Thus, O sinless one, I have revealed this most mystic knowledge to thee. He who understands it gains wisdom and attains the consummation of life.
chapter_title_meaning: The Yoga of the Supreme Divine Personality

sanskrit_text: श्री भगवानुवाच अभयं सत्त्वसंशुद्धिः ज्ञानयोगव्यवस्थितिः। दानं दमश्च यज्ञश्च स्वाध्यायस्तप आर्जवम्।।16.1।।
english_translation: Lord Shri Krishna continued: Fearlessness, clean living, unceasing concentration on wisdom, readiness to give, self-control, a spirit of sacrifice, regular study of the scriptures, austerity, candor,
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Discerning the Divine and Demoniac Natures

sanskrit_text: अहिंसा सत्यमक्रोधस्त्यागः शान्तिरपैशुनम्।दया भूतेष्वलोलुप्त्वं मार्दवं ह्रीरचापलम्।।16.2।।
english_translation: Harmlessness, truth, absence of wrath, renunciation, contentment, straightforwardness, compassion towards all, uncovetousness, courtesy, modesty, and constancy.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Discerning the Divine and Demoniac Natures

sanskrit_text: तेजः क्षमा धृतिः शौचमद्रोहो नातिमानिता। भवन्ति सम्पदं दैवीमभिजातस्य भारत।।16.3।।
english_translation: Valor, forgiveness, fortitude, purity, freedom from hate and vanity—these are the qualities of one who possesses the divine, O Arjuna!
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Discerning the Divine and Demoniac Natures

sanskrit_text: दम्भो दर्पोऽभिमानश्च क्रोधः पारुष्यमेव च।अज्ञानं चाभिजातस्य पार्थ सम्पदमासुरीम्।।16.4।।
english_translation: Hypocrisy, pride, insolence, cruelty, and ignorance belong to those born of godless qualities.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Discerning the Divine and Demoniac Natures

sanskrit_text: दैवी सम्पद्विमोक्षाय निबन्धायासुरी मता।मा शुचः सम्पदं दैवीमभिजातोऽसि पाण्डव।।16.5।।
english_translation: Godly qualities lead to liberation; godless ones lead to bondage. Do not be anxious, Prince! You have the Godly qualities.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Discerning the Divine and Demoniac Natures

sanskrit_text: द्वौ भूतसर्गौ लोकेऽस्मिन् दैव आसुर एव च।दैवो विस्तरशः प्रोक्त आसुरं पार्थ मे श्रृणु।।16.6।।
english_translation: No changes needed.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Discerning the Divine and Demoniac Natures

sanskrit_text: प्रवृत्तिं च निवृत्तिं च जना न विदुरासुराः।न शौचं नापि चाचारो न सत्यं तेषु विद्यते।।16.7।।
english_translation: The godless do not know how to act or renounce; they lack both purity and truth. They do not understand the right principles of conduct.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Discerning the Divine and Demoniac Natures

sanskrit_text: असत्यमप्रतिष्ठं ते जगदाहुरनीश्वरम्।अपरस्परसम्भूतं किमन्यत्कामहैतुकम्।।16.8।।
english_translation: They say the universe is an accident with no purpose and no God. Life is created through sexual union, a product of lust and nothing else.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Discerning the Divine and Demoniac Natures

sanskrit_text: एतां दृष्टिमवष्टभ्य नष्टात्मानोऽल्पबुद्धयः।प्रभवन्त्युग्रकर्माणः क्षयाय जगतोऽहिताः।।16.9।।
english_translation: Thinking thus, these degraded souls, these enemies of mankind—whose intelligence is negligible and whose deeds are monstrous—come into the world only to destroy.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Discerning the Divine and Demoniac Natures

sanskrit_text: काममाश्रित्य दुष्पूरं दम्भमानमदान्विताः।मोहाद्गृहीत्वासद्ग्राहान्प्रवर्तन्तेऽशुचिव्रताः।।16.10।।
english_translation: Giving themselves up to insatiable passions, hypocritically, self-sufficiently, and arrogantly, cherishing false conceptions founded on delusion, they work only to carry out their own unholy purposes.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Discerning the Divine and Demoniac Natures

sanskrit_text: चिन्तामपरिमेयां च प्रलयान्तामुपाश्रिताः।कामोपभोगपरमा एतावदिति निश्िचताः।।16.11।।
english_translation: Poring anxiously over evil resolutions that only end in death, seeking only the gratification of desire as the highest goal, and seeing nothing beyond—
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Discerning the Divine and Demoniac Natures

sanskrit_text: आशापाशशतैर्बद्धाः कामक्रोधपरायणाः।ईहन्ते कामभोगार्थमन्यायेनार्थसञ्चयान्।।16.12।।
english_translation: Caught in the toils of a hundred vain hopes, enslaved by passion and wrath, they accumulate hoards of unjust wealth, only to indulge their sensual desires.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Discerning the Divine and Demoniac Natures

sanskrit_text: इदमद्य मया लब्धमिमं प्राप्स्ये मनोरथम्।इदमस्तीदमपि मे भविष्यति पुनर्धनम्।।16.13।।
english_translation: Today I have gained this; tomorrow I will fulfill another desire; this wealth is mine now, and the rest will soon be mine.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Discerning the Divine and Demoniac Natures

sanskrit_text: असौ मया हतः शत्रुर्हनिष्ये चापरानपि।ईश्वरोऽहमहं भोगी सिद्धोऽहं बलवान्सुखी।।16.14।।
english_translation: I have slain one enemy; I will slay the others too. I am worthy of enjoying; I am the Almighty, perfect, powerful, and happy.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Discerning the Divine and Demoniac Natures

sanskrit_text: आढ्योऽभिजनवानस्मि कोऽन्योऽस्ति सदृशो मया।यक्ष्ये दास्यामि मोदिष्य इत्यज्ञानविमोहिताः।।16.15।।
english_translation: I am wealthy, I am of noble birth; who can compare with me? I will sacrifice, I will give, I will pay—and I will enjoy. Thus blinded by ignorance,
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Discerning the Divine and Demoniac Natures

sanskrit_text: अनेकचित्तविभ्रान्ता मोहजालसमावृताः।प्रसक्ताः कामभोगेषु पतन्ति नरकेऽशुचौ।।16.16।।
english_translation: Perplexed by discordant thoughts, entangled in the snares of desire, infatuated by passion, they sink into the depths of hell.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Discerning the Divine and Demoniac Natures

sanskrit_text: आत्मसम्भाविताः स्तब्धा धनमानमदान्विताः।यजन्ते नामयज्ञैस्ते दम्भेनाविधिपूर्वकम्।।16.17।।
english_translation: Self-conceited, stubborn, wealthy, proud, and insolent, they make a show of their patronage, disregarding the norms of propriety.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Discerning the Divine and Demoniac Natures

sanskrit_text: अहङ्कारं बलं दर्पं कामं क्रोधं च संश्रिताः।मामात्मपरदेहेषु प्रद्विषन्तोऽभ्यसूयकाः।।16.18।।
english_translation: Puffed up by power and inordinate conceit, swayed by lust and wrath, these wicked people hate Me, Who am within them as I am within all.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Discerning the Divine and Demoniac Natures

sanskrit_text: तानहं द्विषतः क्रूरान्संसारेषु नराधमान्।क्षिपाम्यजस्रमशुभानासुरीष्वेव योनिषु।।16.19।।
english_translation: Those who thus hate Me, who are cruel, the dregs of mankind, I condemn them to a continuous, miserable, and godless rebirth.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Discerning the Divine and Demoniac Natures

sanskrit_text: असुरीं योनिमापन्ना मूढा जन्मनि जन्मनि।मामप्राप्यैव कौन्तेय ततो यान्त्यधमां गतिम्।।16.20।।
english_translation: So, reborn, they spend life after life enveloped in delusion, and they never reach Me, O Prince, but degenerate into even lower forms of life.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Discerning the Divine and Demoniac Natures

sanskrit_text: त्रिविधं नरकस्येदं द्वारं नाशनमात्मनः।कामः क्रोधस्तथा लोभस्तस्मादेतत्त्रयं त्यजेत्।।16.21।।
english_translation: The gates of hell are three: lust, wrath, and avarice; they destroy the Self, so avoid them.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Discerning the Divine and Demoniac Natures

sanskrit_text: एतैर्विमुक्तः कौन्तेय तमोद्वारैस्त्रिभिर्नरः।आचरत्यात्मनः श्रेयस्ततो याति परां गतिम्।।16.22।।
english_translation: These are the gates that lead to darkness; if one avoids them, they will ensure their own welfare and eventually attain liberation.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Discerning the Divine and Demoniac Natures

sanskrit_text: यः शास्त्रविधिमुत्सृज्य वर्तते कामकारतः।न स सिद्धिमवाप्नोति न सुखं न परां गतिम्।।16.23।।
english_translation: But he who neglects the commands of the scriptures and follows the promptings of passion does not attain perfection, happiness, or the final goal.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Discerning the Divine and Demoniac Natures

sanskrit_text: तस्माच्छास्त्रं प्रमाणं ते कार्याकार्यव्यवस्थितौ।ज्ञात्वा शास्त्रविधानोक्तं कर्म कर्तुमिहार्हसि।।16.24।।
english_translation: Therefore, whenever there is doubt as to whether you should do something or not, let the scriptures guide your conduct. In the light of the scriptures, you should labor your whole life.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Discerning the Divine and Demoniac Natures

sanskrit_text: अर्जुन उवाचये शास्त्रविधिमुत्सृज्य यजन्ते श्रद्धयाऽन्विताः।तेषां निष्ठा तु का कृष्ण सत्त्वमाहो रजस्तमः।।17.1।।
english_translation: Arjuna asked, "My Lord, what is the condition of those who perform acts of sacrifice not according to the scriptures, but with implicit faith? Is it one of purity, passion, or ignorance?"
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Discerning the Three Divisions of Faith

sanskrit_text: श्री भगवानुवाचत्रिविधा भवति श्रद्धा देहिनां सा स्वभावजा।सात्त्विकी राजसी चैव तामसी चेति तां श्रृणु।।17.2।।
english_translation: Lord Shri Krishna replied: Man has an inherent faith in one or another of the qualities—purity, passion, and ignorance. Now, listen.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Discerning the Three Divisions of Faith

sanskrit_text: सत्त्वानुरूपा सर्वस्य श्रद्धा भवति भारत।श्रद्धामयोऽयं पुरुषो यो यच्छ्रद्धः स एव सः।।17.3।।
english_translation: Every person's faith conforms to their nature. By nature, they are full of faith. They are, in fact, what their faith makes them.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Discerning the Three Divisions of Faith

sanskrit_text: यजन्ते सात्त्विका देवान्यक्षरक्षांसि राजसाः।प्रेतान्भूतगणांश्चान्ये यजन्ते तामसा जनाः।।17.4।।
english_translation: The pure worship the true God; the passionate, the powers of wealth and magic; the ignorant, the spirits of the dead and lower orders of nature.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Discerning the Three Divisions of Faith

sanskrit_text: अशास्त्रविहितं घोरं तप्यन्ते ये तपो जनाः।दम्भाहङ्कारसंयुक्ताः कामरागबलान्विताः।।17.5।।
english_translation: Those who practice austerities not commanded by scripture, who are enslaved to hypocrisy and egotism, who are carried away by the fury of desire and passion,
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Discerning the Three Divisions of Faith

sanskrit_text: कर्षयन्तः शरीरस्थं भूतग्राममचेतसः।मां चैवान्तःशरीरस्थं तान्विद्ध्यासुरनिश्चयान्।।17.6।।
english_translation: They are ignorant and torment the organs of the body, harassing Me who lives within. Know that they are devoted to evil.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Discerning the Three Divisions of Faith

sanskrit_text: आहारस्त्वपि सर्वस्य त्रिविधो भवति प्रियः।यज्ञस्तपस्तथा दानं तेषां भेदमिमं श्रृणु।।17.7।।
english_translation: The food that people enjoy is also threefold, like the ways of sacrifice, austerity, and almsgiving. Listen to the distinction.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Discerning the Three Divisions of Faith

sanskrit_text: आयुःसत्त्वबलारोग्यसुखप्रीतिविवर्धनाः।रस्याः स्निग्धाः स्थिरा हृद्या आहाराः सात्त्विकप्रियाः।।17.8।।
english_translation: The foods that prolong life, increase purity, vigour, health, cheerfulness, and happiness are those that are delicious, soothing, substantial, and agreeable; these are loved by the pure.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Discerning the Three Divisions of Faith

sanskrit_text: कट्वम्ललवणात्युष्णतीक्ष्णरूक्षविदाहिनः।आहारा राजसस्येष्टा दुःखशोकामयप्रदाः।।17.9।।
english_translation: Those in whom passion is dominant like foods that are bitter, sour, salty, overly hot, pungent, dry, and burning. These produce unhappiness, repentance, and disease.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Discerning the Three Divisions of Faith

sanskrit_text: यातयामं गतरसं पूति पर्युषितं च यत्।उच्छिष्टमपि चामेध्यं भोजनं तामसप्रियम्।।17.10।।
english_translation: The ignorant love food that is stale, not nourishing, putrid, and corrupt; the leftovers of others, and unclean.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Discerning the Three Divisions of Faith

sanskrit_text: अफलाकाङ्क्षिभिर्यज्ञो विधिदृष्टो य इज्यते।यष्टव्यमेवेति मनः समाधाय स सात्त्विकः।।17.11।।
english_translation: Sacrifice is pure when it is offered by one who does not covet the fruit of it, when it is done according to the commands of scripture, and with implicit faith that the sacrifice is a duty.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Discerning the Three Divisions of Faith

sanskrit_text: अभिसंधाय तु फलं दम्भार्थमपि चैव यत्।इज्यते भरतश्रेष्ठ तं यज्ञं विद्धि राजसम्।।17.12।।
english_translation: Sacrifice which is performed for the sake of its results, or for self-glorification - that, O best of Aryans, is the product of passion.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Discerning the Three Divisions of Faith

sanskrit_text: विधिहीनमसृष्टान्नं मन्त्रहीनमदक्षिणम्।श्रद्धाविरहितं यज्ञं तामसं परिचक्षते।।17.13।।
english_translation: Sacrifice that is contrary to scriptural command, that is unaccompanied by prayers or gifts of food or money, and is without faith—that is the product of ignorance.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Discerning the Three Divisions of Faith

sanskrit_text: देवद्विजगुरुप्राज्ञपूजनं शौचमार्जवम्।ब्रह्मचर्यमहिंसा च शारीरं तप उच्यते।।17.14।।
english_translation: Worship of God and the Master; respect for the preacher and the philosopher; purity, rectitude, continence, and harmlessness—all of these constitute physical austerity.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Discerning the Three Divisions of Faith

sanskrit_text: अनुद्वेगकरं वाक्यं सत्यं प्रियहितं च यत्।स्वाध्यायाभ्यसनं चैव वाङ्मयं तप उच्यते।।17.15।।
english_translation: Speech that hurts no one, that is true, pleasant to listen to, and beneficial, and the constant study of the scriptures—this is austerity of speech.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Discerning the Three Divisions of Faith

sanskrit_text: मनःप्रसादः सौम्यत्वं मौनमात्मविनिग्रहः।भावसंशुद्धिरित्येतत्तपो मानसमुच्यते।।17.16।।
english_translation: Serenity, kindness, silence, self-control, and purity—these are the austerities of the mind.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Discerning the Three Divisions of Faith

sanskrit_text: श्रद्धया परया तप्तं तपस्तत्ित्रविधं नरैः।अफलाकाङ्क्षिभिर्युक्तैः सात्त्विकं परिचक्षते।।17.17।।
english_translation: These threefold austerities, performed with faith and without thought of reward, can truly be considered pure.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Discerning the Three Divisions of Faith

sanskrit_text: सत्कारमानपूजार्थं तपो दम्भेन चैव यत्।क्रियते तदिह प्रोक्तं राजसं चलमध्रुवम्।।17.18।।
english_translation: Austerity coupled with hypocrisy, or performed for the sake of self-glorification, popularity, or vanity, comes from passion, and its result is always uncertain and temporary.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Discerning the Three Divisions of Faith

sanskrit_text: मूढग्राहेणात्मनो यत्पीडया क्रियते तपः।परस्योत्सादनार्थं वा तत्तामसमुदाहृतम्।।17.19।।
english_translation: Austerity done under delusion, and accompanied with sorcery or the infliction of pain upon oneself or another, may be assumed to spring from ignorance.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Discerning the Three Divisions of Faith

sanskrit_text: दातव्यमिति यद्दानं दीयतेऽनुपकारिणे।देशे काले च पात्रे च तद्दानं सात्त्विकं स्मृतम्।।17.20।।
english_translation: The gift that is given without thought of recompense, believing it should be made, in an appropriate place, at an opportune time, and to a deserving person—such a gift is pure.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Discerning the Three Divisions of Faith

sanskrit_text: यत्तु प्रत्युपकारार्थं फलमुद्दिश्य वा पुनः।दीयते च परिक्लिष्टं तद्दानं राजसं स्मृतम्।।17.21।।
english_translation: That which is given for the sake of the results it will produce, or with the hope of recompense, or grudgingly—that may truly be said to be the outcome of passion.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Discerning the Three Divisions of Faith

sanskrit_text: अदेशकाले यद्दानमपात्रेभ्यश्च दीयते।असत्कृतमवज्ञातं तत्तामसमुदाहृतम्।।17.22।।
english_translation: And that which is given at an inappropriate place or time or to one who is undeserving, or with disrespect or contempt - such a gift is the result of ignorance.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Discerning the Three Divisions of Faith

sanskrit_text: तत्सदिति निर्देशो ब्रह्मणस्त्रिविधः स्मृतः।ब्राह्मणास्तेन वेदाश्च यज्ञाश्च विहिताः पुरा।।17.23।।
english_translation: Om Tat Sat is the triple designation of the Eternal Spirit, by which the Vedic Scriptures, ceremonials, and sacrifices were ordained of old.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Discerning the Three Divisions of Faith

sanskrit_text: तस्मादोमित्युदाहृत्य यज्ञदानतपःक्रियाः।प्रवर्तन्ते विधानोक्ताः सततं ब्रह्मवादिनाम्।।17.24।।
english_translation: Therefore, all acts of sacrifice, gifts, and austerities prescribed by the scriptures are always begun by those who understand the Spirit with the word "Om."
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Discerning the Three Divisions of Faith

sanskrit_text: तदित्यनभिसन्धाय फलं यज्ञतपःक्रियाः।दानक्रियाश्च विविधाः क्रियन्ते मोक्षकाङ्क्षि।।17.25।।
english_translation: Those who desire deliverance begin their acts of sacrifice, austerity, or gift with the word "Tat" (meaning "That"), without thought of reward.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Discerning the Three Divisions of Faith

sanskrit_text: सद्भावे साधुभावे च सदित्येतत्प्रयुज्यते।प्रशस्ते कर्मणि तथा सच्छब्दः पार्थ युज्यते।।17.26।।
english_translation: Sat' means Reality or the highest Good, and also, O Arjuna, it is used to denote an action of exceptional merit.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Discerning the Three Divisions of Faith

sanskrit_text: यज्ञे तपसि दाने च स्थितिः सदिति चोच्यते।कर्म चैव तदर्थीयं सदित्येवाभिधीयते।।17.27।।
english_translation: Conviction in sacrifice, austerity, and giving is also called Sat. So too, an action done only for the Lord's sake.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Discerning the Three Divisions of Faith

sanskrit_text: अश्रद्धया हुतं दत्तं तपस्तप्तं कृतं च यत्।असदित्युच्यते पार्थ न च तत्प्रेत्य नो इह।।17.28।।
english_translation: Whatever is done without faith, whether it be sacrifice, austerity, gift, or anything else, is called Asat (meaning "Unreal"), for it is the negation of Sat, O Arjuna! Such an act has no significance, here or hereafter.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Discerning the Three Divisions of Faith

sanskrit_text: अर्जुन उवाच संन्यासस्य महाबाहो तत्त्वमिच्छामि वेदितुम्। त्यागस्य च हृषीकेश पृथक्केशिनिषूदन।।18.1।।
english_translation: Arjuna asked, "O Mighty One! I desire to know how relinquishment is distinguished from renunciation.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender

sanskrit_text: श्री भगवानुवाच काम्यानां कर्मणां न्यासं संन्यासं कवयो विदुः। सर्वकर्मफलत्यागं प्राहुस्त्यागं विचक्षणाः।।18.2।।
english_translation: Lord Shri Krishna replied: The sages say that renunciation is forgoing an action that springs from desire, and relinquishing is the surrender of its fruit.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender

sanskrit_text: त्याज्यं दोषवदित्येके कर्म प्राहुर्मनीषिणः। यज्ञदानतपःकर्म न त्याज्यमिति चापरे।।18.3।।
english_translation: Some philosophers say that all action is evil and should be abandoned, whereas others maintain that acts of sacrifice, benevolence, and austerity should not be given up.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender

sanskrit_text: निश्चयं श्रृणु मे तत्र त्यागे भरतसत्तम।त्यागो हि पुरुषव्याघ्र त्रिविधः संप्रकीर्तितः।।18.4।।
english_translation: O best of Indians! Listen to my judgment regarding this problem. It has a threefold aspect.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender

sanskrit_text: यज्ञदानतपःकर्म न त्याज्यं कार्यमेव तत्।यज्ञो दानं तपश्चैव पावनानि मनीषिणाम्।।18.5।।
english_translation: Acts of sacrifice, benevolence, and austerity should not be given up, but should be performed, for they purify the aspiring soul.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender

sanskrit_text: एतान्यपि तु कर्माणि सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा फलानि च।कर्तव्यानीति मे पार्थ निश्िचतं मतमुत्तमम्।।18.6।।
english_translation: But they should be done with detachment and without thought of reward. This is my final judgement.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender

sanskrit_text: नियतस्य तु संन्यासः कर्मणो नोपपद्यते।मोहात्तस्य परित्यागस्तामसः परिकीर्तितः।।18.7।।
english_translation: It is not right to give up actions which are obligatory; and if they are misunderstood, it is the result of sheer ignorance.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender

sanskrit_text: दुःखमित्येव यत्कर्म कायक्लेशभयात्त्यजेत्।स कृत्वा राजसं त्यागं नैव त्यागफलं लभेत्।।18.8।।
english_translation: To avoid an action out of fear of physical suffering, as it is likely to be painful, is to act out of passion, and the benefit of renunciation will not be gained.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender

sanskrit_text: कार्यमित्येव यत्कर्म नियतं क्रियतेऽर्जुन।सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा फलं चैव स त्यागः सात्त्विको मतः।।18.9।।
english_translation: He who performs an obligatory action, believing it to be a duty that ought to be done, without any personal desire to do the act or to receive any return—such renunciation is pure.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender

sanskrit_text: न द्वेष्ट्यकुशलं कर्म कुशले नानुषज्जते।त्यागी सत्त्वसमाविष्टो मेधावी छिन्नसंशयः।।18.10।।
english_translation: The wise man who has attained purity, whose doubts are resolved, who is filled with the spirit of self-abnegation, does not shy away from action due to its pain, nor does he crave it due to its pleasure.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender

sanskrit_text: न हि देहभृता शक्यं त्यक्तुं कर्माण्यशेषतः।यस्तु कर्मफलत्यागी स त्यागीत्यभिधीयते।।18.11।।
english_translation: But since those still in the body cannot entirely avoid action, in their case, the abandonment of the fruit of action is considered as complete renunciation.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender

sanskrit_text: अनिष्टमिष्टं मिश्रं च त्रिविधं कर्मणः फलम्।भवत्यत्यागिनां प्रेत्य न तु संन्यासिनां क्वचित्।।18.12।।
english_translation: For those who cannot renounce all desires, the fruit of action hereafter is threefold—good, evil, and partly good and partly evil. But for him who has renounced, there is none.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender

sanskrit_text: पञ्चैतानि महाबाहो कारणानि निबोध मे।सांख्ये कृतान्ते प्रोक्तानि सिद्धये सर्वकर्मणाम्।।18.13।।
english_translation: I will now tell you, O Mighty Man, the five causes that must come together, according to the final decision of philosophy, for an action to be accomplished.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender

sanskrit_text: अधिष्ठानं तथा कर्ता करणं च पृथग्विधम्।विविधाश्च पृथक्चेष्टा दैवं चैवात्र पञ्चमम्।।18.14।।
english_translation: They have a body, a personality, physical organs, and manifold activities and destinies.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender

sanskrit_text: शरीरवाङ्मनोभिर्यत्कर्म प्रारभते नरः।न्याय्यं वा विपरीतं वा पञ्चैते तस्य हेतवः।।18.15।।
english_translation: Whatever action a person performs, whether by muscular effort, speech, or thought, and whether it be right or wrong, these five are the essential causes.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender

sanskrit_text: तत्रैवं सति कर्तारमात्मानं केवलं तु यः।पश्यत्यकृतबुद्धित्वान्न स पश्यति दुर्मतिः।।18.16।।
english_translation: But the fool, who, due to his immature judgment, supposes that it is his own Self alone that acts, perverts the truth and does not see rightly.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender

sanskrit_text: यस्य नाहंकृतो भावो बुद्धिर्यस्य न लिप्यते।हत्वापि स इमाँल्लोकान्न हन्ति न निबध्यते।।18.17।।
english_translation: He who has no pride and whose intellect is unalloyed by attachment, even though he kills these people, he does not kill them, and his act does not bind him.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender

sanskrit_text: ज्ञानं ज्ञेयं परिज्ञाता त्रिविधा कर्मचोदना।करणं कर्म कर्तेति त्रिविधः कर्मसंग्रहः।।18.18।।
english_translation: Knowledge, the knower, and the object of knowledge are the three incentives to action; and the act, the actor, and the instrument are the threefold constituents.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender

sanskrit_text: ज्ञानं कर्म च कर्ता च त्रिधैव गुणभेदतः।प्रोच्यते गुणसंख्याने यथावच्छृणु तान्यपि।।18.19।।
english_translation: The knowledge, the action, and the doer differ according to their qualities. Listen to this as well.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender

sanskrit_text: सर्वभूतेषु येनैकं भावमव्ययमीक्षते।अविभक्तं विभक्तेषु तज्ज्ञानं विद्धि सात्त्विकम्।।18.20।।
english_translation: That knowledge which sees the One Indestructible in all beings, the One Indivisible in all separate lives, can be truly called Pure Knowledge.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender

sanskrit_text: पृथक्त्वेन तु यज्ज्ञानं नानाभावान्पृथग्विधान्।वेत्ति सर्वेषु भूतेषु तज्ज्ञानं विद्धि राजसम्।।18.21।।
english_translation: The knowledge that perceives the manifold existence in all beings as separate comes from passion.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender

sanskrit_text: यत्तु कृत्स्नवदेकस्मिन्कार्ये सक्तमहैतुकम्।अतत्त्वार्थवदल्पं च तत्तामसमुदाहृतम्।।18.22।।
english_translation: But that which clings blindly to one idea as if it were all, without logic, truth, or insight, has its origin in darkness.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender

sanskrit_text: नियतं सङ्गरहितमरागद्वेषतः कृतम्।अफलप्रेप्सुना कर्म यत्तत्सात्त्विकमुच्यते।।18.23।।
english_translation: An obligatory action done by one who is disinterested, who neither likes nor dislikes it, and gives no thought to the consequences that may follow, such an action is Pure.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender

sanskrit_text: यत्तु कामेप्सुना कर्म साहङ्कारेण वा पुनः।क्रियते बहुलायासं तद्राजसमुदाहृतम्।।18.24।।
english_translation: But even though an action involves the most strenuous endeavor, yet if the doer is seeking to gratify their desires and is filled with personal vanity, it may be assumed to originate in passion.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender

sanskrit_text: अनुबन्धं क्षयं हिंसामनपेक्ष्य च पौरुषम्।मोहादारभ्यते कर्म यत्तत्तामसमुच्यते।।18.25।।
english_translation: An action undertaken through delusion, with no regard to the spiritual implications, the capacity of the doer, or the potential harm that may follow, is assumed to be a product of ignorance.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender

sanskrit_text: मुक्तसङ्गोऽनहंवादी धृत्युत्साहसमन्वितः।सिद्ध्यसिद्ध्योर्निर्विकारः कर्ता सात्त्विक उच्यते।।18.26।।
english_translation: But when a person has no sentiment or ego, when they possess courage and confidence, not caring whether they succeed or fail, then their action arises from purity.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender

sanskrit_text: रागी कर्मफलप्रेप्सुर्लुब्धो हिंसात्मकोऽशुचिः।हर्षशोकान्वितः कर्ता राजसः परिकीर्तितः।।18.27।।
english_translation: In one who is impulsive, greedy, looking for reward, violent, impure, and torn between joy and sorrow, it may be assumed that Passion is predominant.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender

sanskrit_text: अयुक्तः प्राकृतः स्तब्धः शठो नैष्कृतिकोऽलसः।विषादी दीर्घसूत्री च कर्ता तामस उच्यते।।18.28।।
english_translation: While he whose purpose is weak, who is low-minded, stubborn, dishonest, malicious, lazy, despondent, and procrastinating—he may be assumed to be in darkness.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender

sanskrit_text: बुद्धेर्भेदं धृतेश्चैव गुणतस्त्रिविधं श्रृणु।प्रोच्यमानमशेषेण पृथक्त्वेन धनञ्जय।।18.29।।
english_translation: Reason and conviction are threefold, according to the quality that is dominant. I will explain them fully and separately, O Arjuna!
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender

sanskrit_text: प्रवृत्तिं च निवृत्तिं च कार्याकार्ये भयाभये।बन्धं मोक्षं च या वेत्ति बुद्धिः सा पार्थ सात्त्विकी।।18.30।।
english_translation: That intellect which understands the creation and dissolution of life, what actions should be done and what not, which discriminates between fear and fearlessness, bondage and deliverance, is Pure.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender

sanskrit_text: यया धर्ममधर्मं च कार्यं चाकार्यमेव च।अयथावत्प्रजानाति बुद्धिः सा पार्थ राजसी।।18.31।।
english_translation: The intellect that does not understand what is right and wrong, and what should be done and not done, is under the sway of Passion.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender

sanskrit_text: अधर्मं धर्ममिति या मन्यते तमसाऽऽवृता।सर्वार्थान्विपरीतांश्च बुद्धिः सा पार्थ तामसी।।18.32।।
english_translation: And that which, shrouded in Ignorance, thinks wrong to be right, and sees everything perversely, O Arjuna, that intellect is ruled by Darkness.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender

sanskrit_text: धृत्या यया धारयते मनःप्राणेन्द्रियक्रियाः।योगेनाव्यभिचारिण्या धृतिः सा पार्थ सात्त्विकी।।18.33।।
english_translation: The conviction and steady concentration with which the mind, the energy, and the senses are controlled—O Arjuna!—are the result of purity.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender

sanskrit_text: यया तु धर्मकामार्थान् धृत्या धारयतेऽर्जुन।प्रसङ्गेन फलाकाङ्क्षी धृतिः सा पार्थ राजसी।।18.34।।
english_translation: The conviction that always holds fast to rituals, self-interest, and wealth for the sake of what they may bring forth comes from passion.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender

sanskrit_text: यया स्वप्नं भयं शोकं विषादं मदमेव च।न विमुञ्चति दुर्मेधा धृतिः सा पार्थ तामसी।।18.35।।
english_translation: And that which clings perversely to false idealism, fear, grief, despair, and vanity is the product of ignorance.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender

sanskrit_text: सुखं त्विदानीं त्रिविधं श्रृणु मे भरतर्षभ।अभ्यासाद्रमते यत्र दुःखान्तं च निगच्छति।।18.36।।
english_translation: Hear further the three kinds of pleasure. That which increases day by day delivers one from misery.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender

sanskrit_text: यत्तदग्रे विषमिव परिणामेऽमृतोपमम्।तत्सुखं सात्त्विकं प्रोक्तमात्मबुद्धिप्रसादजम्।।18.37।।
english_translation: Which at first seems like poison but afterwards acts like nectar—that pleasure is pure, for it is born of wisdom.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender

sanskrit_text: विषयेन्द्रियसंयोगाद्यत्तदग्रेऽमृतोपमम्।परिणामे विषमिव तत्सुखं राजसं स्मृतम्।।18.38।।
english_translation: That which, at first, is like nectar, as the senses revel in their objects, but in the end acts like poison—that pleasure arises from Passion.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender

sanskrit_text: यदग्रे चानुबन्धे च सुखं मोहनमात्मनः।निद्रालस्यप्रमादोत्थं तत्तामसमुदाहृतम्।।18.39।।
english_translation: While the pleasure that drugs the senses from start to finish, which springs from indolence, lethargy, and folly—that pleasure flows from Ignorance.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender

sanskrit_text: न तदस्ति पृथिव्यां वा दिवि देवेषु वा पुनः।सत्त्वं प्रकृतिजैर्मुक्तं यदेभिः स्यात्ित्रभिर्गुणैः।।18.40।।
english_translation: There is nothing anywhere on earth or in the higher worlds that is free from the three Qualities, for they are born of Nature.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender

sanskrit_text: ब्राह्मणक्षत्रियविशां शूद्राणां च परंतप।कर्माणि प्रविभक्तानि स्वभावप्रभवैर्गुणैः।।18.41।।
english_translation: O Arjuna! The duties of spiritual teachers, the soldiers, the traders, and the servants have all been fixed according to the dominant quality in their nature.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender

sanskrit_text: शमो दमस्तपः शौचं क्षान्तिरार्जवमेव च।ज्ञानं विज्ञानमास्तिक्यं ब्रह्मकर्म स्वभावजम्।।18.42।।
english_translation: Serenity, self-restraint, austerity, purity, forgiveness, uprightness, knowledge, wisdom, and faith in God—these constitute the duty of a spiritual teacher.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender

sanskrit_text: शौर्यं तेजो धृतिर्दाक्ष्यं युद्धे चाप्यपलायनम्।दानमीश्वरभावश्च क्षात्रं कर्म स्वभावजम्।।18.43।।
english_translation: Valor, glory, firmness, skill, generosity, steadiness in battle, and the ability to rule—these constitute the duty of a soldier. They flow from his own nature.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender

sanskrit_text: कृषिगौरक्ष्यवाणिज्यं वैश्यकर्म स्वभावजम्।परिचर्यात्मकं कर्म शूद्रस्यापि स्वभावजम्।।18.44।।
english_translation: Agriculture, the protection of cows, and trade are the duties of a trader, in accordance with his nature. The duty of a servant is to serve, which also agrees with his nature.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender

sanskrit_text: स्वे स्वे कर्मण्यभिरतः संसिद्धिं लभते नरः।स्वकर्मनिरतः सिद्धिं यथा विन्दति तच्छृणु।।18.45।।
english_translation: Perfection is attained when one diligently attends to their duty. Listen, and I will tell you how it is attained by one who always minds their own duty.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender

sanskrit_text: यतः प्रवृत्तिर्भूतानां येन सर्वमिदं ततम्।स्वकर्मणा तमभ्यर्च्य सिद्धिं विन्दति मानवः।।18.46।।
english_translation: One reaches perfection by dedicating their actions to God, Who is the source of all being and fills everything.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender

sanskrit_text: श्रेयान्स्वधर्मो विगुणः परधर्मात्स्वनुष्ठितात्।स्वभावनियतं कर्म कुर्वन्नाप्नोति किल्बिषम्।।18.47।।
english_translation: It is better to do one's own duty, however defective it may be, than to follow the duty of another, however well one may perform it. He who does his duty as his own nature reveals it, never commits a sin.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender

sanskrit_text: सहजं कर्म कौन्तेय सदोषमपि न त्यजेत्।सर्वारम्भा हि दोषेण धूमेनाग्निरिवावृताः।।18.48।।
english_translation: The duty that falls to one's lot of its own accord should not be abandoned, though it may have its defects. All acts are marred by defects, just as fire is obscured by smoke.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender

sanskrit_text: असक्तबुद्धिः सर्वत्र जितात्मा विगतस्पृहः।नैष्कर्म्यसिद्धिं परमां संन्यासेनाधिगच्छति।।18.49।।
english_translation: He whose mind is entirely detached, who has conquered himself, and whose desires have vanished, reaches that stage of perfect freedom through his renunciation, where action completes itself and leaves no seed.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender

sanskrit_text: सिद्धिं प्राप्तो यथा ब्रह्म तथाप्नोति निबोध मे।समासेनैव कौन्तेय निष्ठा ज्ञानस्य या परा।।18.50।।
english_translation: I will now state briefly how one who has reached perfection finds the Eternal Spirit, the state of Supreme Wisdom.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender

sanskrit_text: बुद्ध्या विशुद्धया युक्तो धृत्याऽऽत्मानं नियम्य च।शब्दादीन् विषयांस्त्यक्त्वा रागद्वेषौ व्युदस्य च।।18.51।।
english_translation: Guided always by pure reason, bravely restraining himself, renouncing the objects of sense and giving up attachment and hatred; he attains peace.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender

sanskrit_text: विविक्तसेवी लघ्वाशी यतवाक्कायमानसः।ध्यानयोगपरो नित्यं वैराग्यं समुपाश्रितः।।18.52।।
english_translation: Enjoying solitude, being abstemious, having his body, mind, and speech under perfect control, and being absorbed in meditation, he becomes free—always filled with the spirit of renunciation.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender

sanskrit_text: अहङ्कारं बलं दर्पं कामं क्रोधं परिग्रहम्।विमुच्य निर्ममः शान्तो ब्रह्मभूयाय कल्पते।।18.53।।
english_translation: Having abandoned selfishness, power, arrogance, anger, and desire, possessing nothing of his own, and having attained peace, he is fit to join the Eternal Spirit.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender

sanskrit_text: ब्रह्मभूतः प्रसन्नात्मा न शोचति न काङ्क्षति।समः सर्वेषु भूतेषु मद्भक्तिं लभते पराम्।।18.54।।
english_translation: When he unites with the Eternal and his soul knows the bliss of the Self, he feels no desire or regret, he regards all beings equally, and enjoys the blessing of supreme devotion to Me.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender

sanskrit_text: भक्त्या मामभिजानाति यावान्यश्चास्मि तत्त्वतः।ततो मां तत्त्वतो ज्ञात्वा विशते तदनन्तरम्।।18.55।।
english_translation: By such devotion, he sees Me, who I am and what I am; and thus realizing the truth, he enters into My kingdom.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender

sanskrit_text: सर्वकर्माण्यपि सदा कुर्वाणो मद्व्यपाश्रयः।मत्प्रसादादवाप्नोति शाश्वतं पदमव्ययम्।।18.56।।
english_translation: Relying on Me in all his actions and doing them for My sake, he attains, by My grace, eternal and unchangeable life.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender

sanskrit_text: चेतसा सर्वकर्माणि मयि संन्यस्य मत्परः।बुद्धियोगमुपाश्रित्य मच्चित्तः सततं भव।।18.57।।
english_translation: Surrender your actions to Me, live in Me, focus your intellect on Me, and always think of Me.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender

sanskrit_text: मच्चित्तः सर्वदुर्गाणि मत्प्रसादात्तरिष्यसि।अथ चेत्त्वमहङ्कारान्न श्रोष्यसि विनङ्क्ष्यसि।।18.58।।
english_translation: Fix your mind on Me, and by My grace you will overcome the obstacles in your path. But if, misled by pride, you do not listen, then you will indeed be lost.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender

sanskrit_text: यदहङ्कारमाश्रित्य न योत्स्य इति मन्यसे।मिथ्यैष व्यवसायस्ते प्रकृतिस्त्वां नियोक्ष्यति।।18.59।।
english_translation: If you in your vanity think of avoiding this fight, your will shall not be fulfilled, for Nature herself will compel you.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender

sanskrit_text: स्वभावजेन कौन्तेय निबद्धः स्वेन कर्मणा।कर्तुं नेच्छसि यन्मोहात्करिष्यस्यवशोऽपि तत्।।18.60।।
english_translation: O Arjuna! Your duty binds you. It has arisen from your own nature, and that which you do not desire to do in your delusion, you will do that very thing. You are helpless.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender

sanskrit_text: ईश्वरः सर्वभूतानां हृद्देशेऽर्जुन तिष्ठति।भ्रामयन्सर्वभूतानि यन्त्रारूढानि मायया।।18.61।।
english_translation: God dwells in the hearts of all beings, O Arjuna! He causes them to revolve, as it were, on a wheel, by His mystic power.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender

sanskrit_text: तमेव शरणं गच्छ सर्वभावेन भारत।तत्प्रसादात्परां शान्तिं स्थानं प्राप्स्यसि शाश्वतम्।।18.62।।
english_translation: With all your strength, fly to Him and surrender yourself, and by His grace you will attain Supreme Peace and reach the Eternal Home.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender

sanskrit_text: इति ते ज्ञानमाख्यातं गुह्याद्गुह्यतरं मया।विमृश्यैतदशेषेण यथेच्छसि तथा कुरु।।18.63।।
english_translation: Thus, I have revealed to you the truth, the mystery of mysteries. Having thought it over, you are free to act as you wish.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender

sanskrit_text: सर्वगुह्यतमं भूयः श्रृणु मे परमं वचः।इष्टोऽसि मे दृढमिति ततो वक्ष्यामि ते हितम्।।18.64।।
english_translation: Listen to My last word once more, the deepest secret of all; you are My beloved, you are My friend, and I speak for your welfare.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender

sanskrit_text: मन्मना भव मद्भक्तो मद्याजी मां नमस्कुरु।मामेवैष्यसि सत्यं ते प्रतिजाने प्रियोऽसि मे।।18.65।।
english_translation: Dedicate yourself to Me, worship Me, sacrifice all for Me, prostrate yourself before Me, and you will surely come to Me. I truly pledge to you; you are My beloved.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender

sanskrit_text: सर्वधर्मान्परित्यज्य मामेकं शरणं व्रज।अहं त्वा सर्वपापेभ्यो मोक्षयिष्यामि मा शुचः।।18.66।।
english_translation: Give up your earthly duties, surrender yourself to Me alone. Do not be anxious; I will absolve you from all your sins.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender

sanskrit_text: इदं ते नातपस्काय नाभक्ताय कदाचन।न चाशुश्रूषवे वाच्यं न च मां योऽभ्यसूयति।।18.67।।
english_translation: Do not speak this to one who has not practiced austerities, or to one who does not love, or who will not listen, or who mocks.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender

sanskrit_text: य इमं परमं गुह्यं मद्भक्तेष्वभिधास्यति।भक्ितं मयि परां कृत्वा मामेवैष्यत्यसंशयः।।18.68।।
english_translation: But he who teaches this great secret to My devotees, his is the highest devotion, and he shall surely come to Me.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender

sanskrit_text: न च तस्मान्मनुष्येषु कश्िचन्मे प्रियकृत्तमः।भविता न च मे तस्मादन्यः प्रियतरो भुवि।।18.69।।
english_translation: There is no one among men who can perform a service dearer to Me than this, nor is there any man on earth more beloved by Me than him.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender

sanskrit_text: अध्येष्यते च य इमं धर्म्यं संवादमावयोः।ज्ञानयज्ञेन तेनाहमिष्टः स्यामिति मे मतिः।।18.70।।
english_translation: He who will study this spiritual discourse of ours, I assure you, they shall thereby worship Me at the altar of Wisdom.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender

sanskrit_text: श्रद्धावाननसूयश्च श्रृणुयादपि यो नरः।सोऽपि मुक्तः शुभाँल्लोकान्प्राप्नुयात्पुण्यकर्मणाम्।।18.71।।
english_translation: Yes, he who listens to it with faith and without doubt, even he, freed from evil, will rise to the worlds which the virtuous attain through righteous deeds.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender

sanskrit_text: कच्चिदेतच्छ्रुतं पार्थ त्वयैकाग्रेण चेतसा।कच्चिदज्ञानसंमोहः प्रनष्टस्ते धनञ्जय।।18.72।।
english_translation: O Arjuna, have you listened attentively to My words? Has your ignorance and delusion gone?
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender

sanskrit_text: अर्जुन उवाचनष्टो मोहः स्मृतिर्लब्धा त्वत्प्रसादान्मयाच्युत।स्थितोऽस्मि गतसन्देहः करिष्ये वचनं तव।।18.73।।
english_translation: Arjuna replied: "My Lord! O Immutable One! My delusion has fled. By Your Grace, O Changeless One, the light has dawned. My doubts have been dispelled, and I stand before You ready to do Your will."
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender

sanskrit_text: सञ्जय उवाचइत्यहं वासुदेवस्य पार्थस्य च महात्मनः।संवादमिममश्रौषमद्भुतं रोमहर्षणम्।।18.74।।
english_translation: Sanjaya said: "I heard this rare, wonderful, and soul-stirring discourse between Lord Shri Krishna and the great-souled Arjuna.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender

sanskrit_text: व्यासप्रसादाच्छ्रुतवानेतद्गुह्यमहं परम्।योगं योगेश्वरात्कृष्णात्साक्षात्कथयतः स्वयम्।।18.75।।
english_translation: Through the blessing of the sage Vyasa, I heard this secret and noble science from the lips of its Master, Lord Shri Krishna.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender

sanskrit_text: राजन्संस्मृत्य संस्मृत्य संवादमिममद्भुतम्।केशवार्जुनयोः पुण्यं हृष्यामि च मुहुर्मुहुः।।18.76।।
english_translation: O King! The more I think of that marvelous and holy discourse, the more I lose myself in joy.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender

sanskrit_text: तच्च संस्मृत्य संस्मृत्य रूपमत्यद्भुतं हरेः। विस्मयो मे महान् राजन् हृष्यामि च पुनः पुनः।।18.77।।
english_translation: As I recall again and again the exceeding beauty of the Lord, I am filled with amazement and joy.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender

sanskrit_text: यत्र योगेश्वरः कृष्णो यत्र पार्थो धनुर्धरः। तत्र श्रीर्विजयो भूतिर्ध्रुवा नीतिर्मतिर्मम।।18.78।
english_translation: Wherever Lord Shri Krishna, the Prince of Wisdom, and Arjuna, the Great Archer, are, I am certain that good fortune, victory, happiness, and righteousness will follow.
chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender
